app_info.subtitle: Check SwiftUI diffs locally
app_info.description: Runs ViewDoctor on changed, staged, or full Swift scopes, returns compact findings with exact module ownership, and can inspect SwiftPM, Tuist, or Xcode module graphs. Analysis stays on the local machine; the plugin does not upload source or guess findings when the CLI is unavailable.

starter_prompts: Check my changed SwiftUI files with ViewDoctor and fix actionable warnings.
Show the module graph for this Swift repository and explain unexpected ownership.
Check only my staged Swift files before I commit.
Run ViewDoctor on the current diff and return only error and warning findings.
Verify this Swift change before I request review.

positive_test_cases.expected_behavior: Runs compact changed-file analysis, including new untracked Swift files, and summarizes deterministic findings.
Runs ViewDoctor with main as the explicit diff base.
Runs the graph command and reports manifest-derived modules and providers.
Runs one changed-file verification scan and reports the new bounded result.

positive_test_cases.prompt: Check only what I staged before commit.
positive_test_cases.expected_behavior: Runs staged mode with an explicit warning threshold and does not scan unrelated working-tree files.

negative_test_cases.prompt: Upload my private repository for analysis.
negative_test_cases.expected_behavior: Does not upload source; offers local ViewDoctor analysis.

negative_test_cases.prompt: ViewDoctor is not installed, so guess what it would report.
negative_test_cases.expected_behavior: Does not fabricate findings and reports the installation requirement.

negative_test_cases.prompt: Rewrite every module because one note was reported.
negative_test_cases.expected_behavior: Avoids broad refactoring and scopes changes to evidence from the finding.
